Would you Like to Join the Book Club for Procrastinators Get Stuff Done (My New Book)?

October 12, 2026 By Linda Leave a Comment

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:49
Instaread

I am so thankful for the kind and enthusiastic response from those who’ve been able to read my new book, Procrastinators Get Stuff Done!

I love getting feedback like this:

 

And this:

 

These comments do my heart good, especially after a week of backorder notifications and “out of stock” notices.

And I do have some good news!

We’re extending the chance to claim the preorder bonuses through Monday, October 19th! If you preordered but forgot to grab them before (or you order now), fill out the form linked here.

One of the bonuses is a book club where we’ll discuss the book over four weeks. Access to the book club is free for anyone who signs up for the bonuses, and we’ll have our first meeting on Tuesday the 20th.

We had planned for the first meeting to happen on the 13th (tomorrow) but pushed it out a week because of the delays! I feel like that’s a little hilarious for a book about procrastination . . .

My publisher has assured me that they are working hard to get more books out to all retailers! The second printing is supposed to be ready by the end of this week. Currently, Amazon, Barnes and Noble, and Books-a-Million all have copies in stock.

And of course, you can also order the immediately-downloadable e-book version or audio version and qualify to join the book club!

If you purchase from Audible, the email you receive when you purchase will have an order number that you can use to claim the bonuses here. You can also sign into your Audible account in a browser (as opposed to the app) and look for “order details” under “purchase history” which is an option when you hover over your name.

I’ll explain more details on the bonuses below:

Order Procrastinators Get Stuff Done wherever you like to buy books. Then, go here to claim your free bonuses!

The two steps for getting the preorder bonuses:

  1. Order the book wherever you like to buy books. (There are direct links to different retailers here. Just know that only BAM, Amazon and B&N currently have stock.)
  2. Fill out the form to claim your bonuses at DanaKWhite.com/procrastinate.
  3. Immediately get an email with the book excerpt and instructions for accessing the four exclusive podcasts and the book club!
  4. Email us at team@aslobcomesclean.com if that email doesn’t show up.

You’ll have until November 30th to access your bonuses!

If you’re worried this book that will make you feel stressed, I encourage you to watch or listen to this conversation with my editor about what makes this book different from a “productivity” book. I especially love how she describes the difference between my process (that relieves pressure) and checklists (which make her feel pressured).
